messages:
tara (docs): quick sync — product wants a short public deprecation banner + a full migration playbook for v1 -> v2 text endpoints. need owner for docs PR, code snippets, and FAQ. who can take this? :wave:
ben (eng): I can draft the migration playbook and troubleshooting table. will need canonical list of breaking changes & any retirement schedule.
zoe (sdk): Breaking list: header -> x-rw-api-key replacement (was Authorization), endpoint surface moved from /v1/generate to /v2/responses, payload key prompt -> input, and streaming framing changed (event ordering + partial frames). also a small token-count diff.
tara (docs): thanks. request curl + TS + python minimal diffs for quickstart. banner must be snappy (< 80 chars). also need email subject suggestions and console banner copy.
omar (product): retirement target: alias redwood/text-legacy -> retired 2026-06-18T23:59:00Z. we'll do a 30-day public notice starting 2026-05-19. docs should include alias pinning instructions and contact/support exception text.
ben (eng): infra ok with 30-day window. I'll add oncall checklist items for the rollout. also suggest adding a short rollback playbook if we see error spikes.
zoe (sdk): small snippets (please paste into docs):
```bash
# v1 curl
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

# v2 curl
curl -X POST \
  -H "x-rw-api-key: $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
```

```ts
// v1 (TS) - old SDK
import RW from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const c = new RW({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await c.generate({ model: 'redwood/text-legacy', prompt: 'hi' });

// v2 (TS) - new SDK
import { Redwood } from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const r = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await r.responses.create({ model: 'redwood/text-v2', input: 'hi' });
```

tara (docs): perfect — i'll keep a 2-line quickstart on the banner and the full snippets in the migration appendix. add a short FAQ: how to find old header usage (grep pattern) and how to pin aliases.
omar (product): banner draft: "Deprecation: v1 text endpoints retire 2026-06-18. See migration playbook." email subject draft: "Action required: Migrate to Redwood text v2 endpoints"
ben (eng): streaming note: older clients may see interleaved meta frames; recommend SDK >= 2.1.0. i'll add a snippet showing how to reassemble partial frames in Node.
zoe (sdk): also call out token accounting differences in the migration appendix — customers often ask about cost deltas.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy successful: text-v2 service deployed to us-east-1 at 2026-05-06T14:22:00Z.
tara (docs): action items: 1) ben opens docs PR with migration playbook + banner + FAQ + rollback steps, 2) zoe updates SDK README and drops snippets, 3) omar finalizes announcement timing and legal copy. target merge: 2026-05-17 so marketing can review.
ben (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2527 — draft migration playbook, checklist, and troubleshooting table. will add Node streaming snippet shortly.
zoe (sdk): SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/426 — adds migration note and quick code diffs.
tara (docs): thanks — i'll add email draft to the docs PR and prepare console banner copy. please react :thumbsup: on PRs once you've reviewed so I can schedule banners and send the email.
ben (eng): added oncall tasks to the checklist and a short rollback plan (scale down, revert alias mapping, re-enable v1 in limited mode).
zoe (sdk): small FAQ entry for auth header grep: run `git grep "Authorization: Bearer" -- "**/*.js"` and replace with `x-rw-api-key` header. i'll add the one-liner to README too.
omar (product): confirmed 30-day window starting 2026-05-19. legal signoff pending but expected.
tara (docs): great — i'll merge once PR cross-links are in and approvals are present. will post final banner + email copy here. thanks everyone! :tada:
